knowledge_gaps: The gate logit is additive in current and historical features: aᵀcurrent + bᵀhistory + c. It lacks an explicit feature interaction, limiting claims about matching a historical item to current context. Compare against static per-tap gates before attributing gains to contextual selection.

An unchanged current-position convolution tap does not preserve its complete influence: the current hidden state also controls every historical gate. Older information embedded in that state can therefore affect historical contributions.

Integration instructions conflict: one passage transposes inputs and outputs around the adapter, while its implementation accepts and returns B×L×C. Resolve the tensor layout and specify the exact modified block forward, predictor writer and diagnostic implementation.

The reported 0.5325 versus 0.5300 values are labeled combined_score in the supplied history. Confirm their provenance as pinned four-category macro validation HR@10 before interpreting the difference as an improvement. Duplicate inspiration entries are not independent replications.

The experiment lacks a concrete remaining-budget allocation, checkpoint inspection schedule, gate optimizer settings and fully specified prefix interventions. Per-tap linear operations may substantially increase runtime. Originality 4 and difficulty 6 are plausible provisional judgments; potential 7 remains speculative without measured feasibility or validation gains.
